mechanism: Olanzapine may increase medroxyprogesterone levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and additive metabolic effects, while medroxyprogesterone may increase olanzapine metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, creating bidirectional interaction with potential loss of antipsychotic or contraceptive efficacy.
action: Monitor for reduced antipsychotic efficacy and contraceptive effectiveness; consider alternative contraceptive methods or dose adjustment of olanzapine if breakthrough symptoms occur.
